name: Sabar Flex India Ltd.
summary: Sabar Flex India Ltd. manufactures and supplies a diverse range of flexible packaging materials derived from plastics. Its product portfolio includes flexible packaging, stretch wrap and silage stretch films, low-density polyethylene shrink wrap films, multilayer coextruded polyethylene and co-polymer films, mulch and color plastic film, liner bags, and printing inks. The company specializes in gravure printing and the production of customized laminate structures and specialized fancy pouches for both consumer and bulk packaging. Sabar Flex India caters to various industries such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, food and beverage, FMCG, agriculture, e-commerce, consumer durables, stationery, and industrial products within the Indian market, also positioning itself for exports. Its operations are focused on providing tailored packaging solutions to meet specific product protection and branding requirements for a broad client base.
